profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: A serial entrepreneur and senior software engineer (front-end, back-end, devops, infrastructure, and other experience) with 13 years of software engineering and 20 years of small business management (up to 50 member teams). Author of multiple languages. Builder of core libraries. Developer of custom frameworks. Creator of developer and CI/CD tools. Designer of web platforms, applications, and management systems. Deep knowledge of GNU Linux and developer tooling. A trustworthy self-starter, leader, and software enthusiast. Strong foundation of programming fundamentals like algorithmic design, data structures, and programming paradigms. Producer of clean, well-organized code. Productive teammate and happy mentor. Looking to improve your life every step along the way.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Rebuilding VitalConnect's hospital, patient, monitoring technician, support staff, and administrative command center, VistaCenter. Handling all aspects of front-end and back-end technology. Architecting APIs, assets, servers, databases, development process, platform specification, and more.

positions.title: Founder & Software Engineer
positions.description: Created a static website platform that includes custom JavaScript, Sass, Handlebars, design, and Nginx frameworks, core libraries, solid resource, API, and database architecture, and automatic linting, bundling, compilation, versioning, and delivery of all assets.

positions.title: Founder & Software Engineer
positions.description: Created a security focused operating system built on top of Xen and Qubes. Designed to utilize a unikernel and separate VM instance for each application process started. Used technologies like POSIX Bourne shell, Bash, Python, C, Xen, Dracut, Plymouth, Systemd, X, Ext4, Dm-crypt, Iptables, NetworkManager, OpenVPN, Tinyproxy, Alsa, and Pulse.

positions.title: Technical Consultant
positions.description: Developed cross-browser, adaptive, and responsive web apps with technologies like HTML, Handlebars, CSS, Sass, Photoshop, JavaScript, React, JSDoc, Closure Compiler, Mocha, Cypress, Node.js, and Nginx. Conducted front-end and back-end security reviews. Acted as an external CTO by providing technical strategies, culture, and guidance. Client industries spanned from health care to construction to e-commerce.

positions.title: Founder & Software Engineer
positions.description: Created a library of critical data structures missing from the JavaScript standard library for competitive programming or general use purposes. Actively use the library in competitions. Designed to offer flexibility and functionality with many options and operations for each class as well as reliability with 100% code coverage.

positions.title: Founder & Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed a core Bash library, preprocessor, and build tool. Includes POSIX and GNU style shell commands as well as a standalone Bash script wrapper. Offers Bash environment sanitization, script and configuration file installation and removal, macro expansion made for scripts and configuration files, a POSIX and GNU option style argument parser, conditional tests for the file system, environment, and program termination, improved file creation and deletion, improved stdout and stderr printing, and improved error handling. Makes any required shell script writing for DevOps much easier. Avoid nasty bugs, write less code, clarify script roles and settings, deploy scripts and configs, and get better output.

positions.title: Founder & Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed a core functional JavaScript library that is intended to replace almost all native JavaScript interaction. Includes hundreds of custom algorithms written to be high performing, clear, and maintainable. Helps JavaScript developers avoid native pitfalls such as + overloading and unequal equality, adds new functionality such as immutability and strong typing, and improves Node.js file system and shell calls.

positions.title: Founder & Software Engineer
positions.description: Authored a preprocessing language for JavaScript. Includes macro expansion followed by parsing of conditionals, groups, and inclusions. Created a Node.js preprocessor.

positions.title: Founder & Software Engineer
positions.description: Authored a human-readable data serialization language. Includes convenient formatting for simple data types, line terminated data entry, native import functionality, and file based object creation. Created a Node.js parser.

positions.title: Founder & Software Engineer
positions.description: Created a JavaScript question manager web application to help others improve their skills with JavaScript and fundamental computer science topics such as algorithmic design and data structures. Answered and explained sample interview questions from FAANG corporations. Utilized prototypical and Crockford-style OOP as well as lexical analysis of JavaScript for a prettifier within the source.

positions.title: Founder & Software Engineer
positions.description: Created a Node.js task runner.

positions.title: Founder & Software Engineer
positions.description: Created a Node.js logger that features detailed formatting options and functional shortcuts.

positions.title: Founder & Software Engineer
positions.description: Created a console wrapper that fixes cross-browser bugs and adds features like method level log, breakpoint, and timer control.

positions.title: Founder, CEO, & Software Engineer
positions.description: Founded a human emotion analytics company. Recruited a team of engineers and data scientists to build prototypes. Focused mainly on computer vision. Created a web-based business management system and analytics dashboard with technologies like D3.js, Handlebars, Sass, JavaScript, MySQL, and Node.js. Created a deep learning environment and toolkit setup with Bash and Python.

positions.title: Founder / Owner
positions.description: Founded a consulting firm with the purpose of helping entrepreneurs embrace and share their personalities and values with the world. Consulted on topics such as business, technology, sales, marketing, start-up, and personal development strategies. Designed identities, developed web apps, conducted marketing campaigns, and found value-adding partnerships for start-ups.

positions.title: Founder / Partner
positions.description: Bootstrapped to over $1M in revenue in just 8 months. Designed the company's marketing and sales strategies as well as developed a web-based business management system with a custom RESTful framework using PHP, MySQL, jQuery, and Apache that interfaced with the insurance claims database and managed every section of the business (from clients to taxes). Managed many construction projects interfacing with clients, sub-contractors, employees, and insurance adjusters. Recruited and trained the sales team. Employed up to 50 employees and sub-contractors at one time.

positions.title: Founder / Owner
positions.description: Gave small business owners guides to choose the best phone, fax, print, hosting, domain, email, seo, copywriting, and legal services. Profited through affiliate links, developed web sites, and designed logos and other marketing materials.

positions.title: Founder / Owner
positions.description: Offered commercial and residential window, power, roof, and gutter cleaning services. Received steady and passive income by creating a contract-based system for my clients and paying my employees and salesmen commission per job.

company.name: Sparkle And Shine Cleaning Solutions LLC

positions.title: Account Executive
positions.description: Joined the founding team for this startup dedicated to selling digital advertising space at displays mounted in public and private venues such as hospitals, restaurants, and grocery stores. Focused on finding new clients and display partnerships. Setup meetings with corporate companies like Brookshires and Raising Canes via cold calls.

positions.title: Founder / Owner
positions.description: Professionally maintained commercial and residential lawns. Utilized door to door sales to get clients. Hired high school peers to help fulfill services.

projects.title: LeetCode Competitions
projects.description: I regularly compete in programming competitions on LeetCode. In November of 2022 I reached a rating of 1,834 that placed me in the top 5% of all LeetCode competitors. Since October of 2022 I have maintained a minimum rating of 1,750 that has kept me in the top 10% of all LeetCode competitors at all times.

projects.title: NeetCode (Collaborator & Contributor)
projects.description: I authored numerous algorithms that solved a large selection of LeetCode questions designed to improve a programmer's skillset and offer them a sturdy foundation in fundamental computer science algorithms and data structures. The project has received thousands of stars on GitHub and reached many thousands of users.
